name: Coldridge Valley
summary: In Coldridge Valley, young dwarves and gnome refugees train for service to Ironforge. Snow blankets the sheltered vale in Dun Morogh's southwestern heights, and Coldridge Pass is its lone route to the wider mountain realm.

sections.title: A Secluded Proving Ground
sections.body: Anvilmar is where new recruits learn to fight, move unseen, and wield sorcery. Veteran dwarven instructors train them alongside displaced gnome scholars. Beyond the hall, snow covers the valley floor, where boars and hungry winter wolves test the novices' skill at surviving the frontier. Sheer cliffs keep the vale apart from much of Dun Morogh's trade.

sections.title: Encroaching Foes
sections.body: Frostmane trolls camp in the valley, including at Frostmane Hovel, and skirmish with mountaineers over their ancestral claims against dwarven encroachment. Rockjaw troggs have overrun Coldridge Pass, the tunnel linking the valley to Kharanos. With the pass blocked, travelers and supplies cannot move freely between the valley and Ironforge, the mountain realm's high seat.

faq.q: How do you leave Coldridge Valley?
faq.answer: Coldridge Pass is the only overland route out of the valley. The snowy tunnel cuts northeast through the mountain ridge, then the road runs east toward Kharanos and onward to Ironforge's great gates.

faq.q: Why are gnomes starting here alongside dwarves?
faq.answer: Surviving gnomes fled to Dun Morogh after troggs and radioactive fallout brought the tragic fall of Gnomeregan. King Magni Bronzebeard welcomed High Tinker Mekkatorque's people, and many exiled gnomish apprentices now train beside young dwarves in Anvilmar.

faq.q: What threats are troubling the valley?
faq.answer: Frostmane trolls resent dwarven settlements on their mountain territory, while Rockjaw troggs have clawed up from the deep earth and blocked Coldridge Pass. Wolves and boars also harass unwary travelers.

Anvilmar is the central fortress-lodge and settlement in Coldridge Valley. It houses class trainers, forge-masters, and local mountaineer officers, who coordinate the valley's defense and prepare newly forged adventurers for the wider world.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you take your first steps beyond the hearth in the traditional training ground of Bronzebeard mountaineers and clerics, preparing to serve the High Seat.
As a gnome exiled from Gnomeregan, you find a safe haven in Coldridge Valley's snows, where you can master spells and machinery alongside your dwarven hosts.
